comments.body:
Thanks for catching this and updating the Google defaults consistently. The model choice looks good. Could you also include a small request-parameter cleanup for Gemini 3.8?

`GoogleProvider` still sends `temperature` and `top_p` in both its SDK and REST requests, and `build_google_test_payload()` sends `temperature: 0`. Google's [Gemini 3.8 migration guide](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/whats-new-gemini-3.8#migration-checklist) says to remove these deprecated parameters. The model currently ignores them, so those settings no longer affect the response.

Could you omit those fields for the newer models while preserving support for older models that still accept them, and add a regression test for the generation and connection-test payloads? The new test checks the default model name, but doesn't cover what we actually send to the API. Thanks!

Thanks, added in dc97372. `GoogleProvider` now leaves out `temperature` and `top_p` for Gemini 3 and later, on both the SDK and REST paths, and the connection test payload takes the model it tests and leaves out `temperature: 0` for those models. Older models and model names without a Gemini version still get both fields, so existing setups keep their settings. New tests check the generation requests (SDK and REST) and the connection-test payload for a Gemini 3 model and an older one.
fix: replace the retired gemini-1.5-flash default Google model- #131
